title: Compound V cross-model review receipt (SCOPED+)
description:
The receipt `/v:dispatch` step 8 writes to `receipts/cross-model.json` after running the mandatory cross-model second opinion on a `triage.flavor: scoped_plus` run. It EXISTS because `schemas/plan-review.schema.json` cannot carry it: that document is `additionalProperties: false` and its only producer is `codex exec --output-schema`, which emits findings and nothing else — no run, no pre-eval, no diff. So the driver's structured output is NESTED here, under `review`, inside a flat envelope that adds the three binding fields the validator checks (`run_id`, `pre_eval_id`, `diff_digest`) plus the self-integrity `digest`.

The review itself stays ADVISORY — the orchestrator arbitrates, exactly as for `/v:review-plan`. What is NOT advisory is that it RAN, on THIS run, over THIS diff: `compound-v-validate-manifest.py --require-cross-model-receipt <path>` refuses a receipt whose `run_id`/`pre_eval_id` disagree with the manifest, whose `diff_digest` is malformed or disagrees with `--expected-diff-digest`, or whose `digest` does not re-derive from its own canonical bytes.

run_id.description: The run this receipt belongs to — MUST equal the manifest's `run_id`.

pre_eval_id.description: The write-once pre-eval id from the manifest's `triage.pre_eval_id` — the cross-artifact binding key that ties receipt, record and manifest to one decision.

diff_digest.description: 'sha256:'+sha256 over the bytes of the sealed patch the reviewer was given (the `--plan-file` step 8 passes). Sealed under `digest`, so the reviewed diff cannot be swapped after the fact; `--expected-diff-digest` lets the caller re-assert it against the bytes it sealed.

reviewer_backend.description: MUST be codex. The point of the SCOPED+ receipt is a DIFFERENT model family from the one that wrote the code and the one that reviews it in-harness; a Claude-on-Claude second opinion is not a second opinion.

reviewer_model.description: The concrete model the driver resolved to (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol). Recorded, not constrained: the codex family map moves faster than this schema.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the receipt was written.

review.description: The driver's structured output, verbatim — a document valid against `schemas/plan-review.schema.json` (`verdict`, `summary`, `findings`, `blind_spots_checked`). The validator checks it against that schema; it never re-interprets the findings, and a `concerns`/`reject` verdict is NOT itself a violation (the orchestrator arbitrates).

digest.description: REQUIRED self-integrity digest: 'sha256:'+sha256(canonical_json(receipt without `digest`)), sealed and verified with the SHARED primitive `compound-v-taxonomy.record_digest(receipt, exclude_field='digest')` — the same convention as the pre-eval record and the fast-path receipt, so producer and consumer can never drift.
